programme.desc: 'S26/E4 - Brunch Bites'. Ree Drummond serves up effortless brunch ideas. She takes four favourites to the next level, from a leftover frittata sandwich board to a crispy A.M. wrap.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S26/E5 - A Little Healthier'. Ree shakes up well-loved recipes and makes them a bit healthier. She puts a spin on the family's takeaway favourite and skips the crust for her classic apple pie.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S26/E6 - Ladd's Birthday'. Ree celebrates her husband's birthday with his favourite foods. She serves steak with roasted garlic butter, gratin potatoes and a cowboy-style chopped salad board.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S26/E7 - Underappreciated'. Ree creates recipes featuring unsung hero ingredients. Canned foods reveal hidden talents in her delectable salmon burgers and spam fried rice.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S26/E8 - Vacation At Home'. Ree makes global dishes from her cosy kitchen. She celebrates exotic British food with a full English breakfast and makes a delicious chicken tagine.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S26/E9 - Skillet Stories'. Ree opens her book of skillet stories, cooking up new dishes in pans. Her menu includes a strawberry almond pan cake, breakfast totchos and tortellini puttanesca.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S17/E1 - Fiesta In A Flash'. Five food experts present fun facts and delicious recipes. From simple dinner ideas to the latest food trends, the hosts cover all things fun in food.

programme.title: Next Baking Master: Paris
